nodes.title: Criminal Charges Involved
nodes.escalation_message: This situation involves criminal charges or criminal history, which can have severe and irreversible consequences — including imprisonment. You should contact a criminal defense attorney immediately. Many public defender offices and legal aid organizations offer free consultations.

nodes.title: Immigration Consequences
nodes.escalation_message: Immigration consequences can be severe, irreversible, and life-altering — including deportation and permanent bars to reentry. Please consult an accredited immigration attorney or DOJ-accredited representative before taking any action. Do not sign any documents related to your immigration status without legal advice.

nodes.title: Child Custody or Child Welfare Involved
nodes.escalation_message: Matters involving child custody, child support, and child welfare agencies are legally complex and outcomes significantly affect families. You should consult a family law attorney. Many legal aid organizations have family law units that can assist low-income individuals.
resources: Self-help family law facilitator at courthouse

nodes.title: Domestic Violence or Stalking
nodes.escalation_message: If you are experiencing domestic violence, stalking, or feel unsafe, please reach out for help immediately. Legal protections including emergency protective orders are available. Your safety is the priority.
resources: Legal aid domestic violence units (many offer emergency same-day assistance)

nodes.title: Bankruptcy Situation
nodes.escalation_message: Bankruptcy involves complex federal law, strict procedural requirements, and significant long-term financial consequences. Filing incorrectly can result in dismissal or fraud allegations. Consult a bankruptcy attorney — many offer free initial consultations and reduced fees for low-income filers.
resources: National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys (nacba.org)
Upsolve.org (free bankruptcy filing tool for simple Chapter 7)

nodes.title: Complex Contract or Business Dispute
nodes.escalation_message: This appears to involve a significant contract or business dispute. These matters often involve complex legal and financial issues where the cost of an error can far exceed the cost of legal representation. Consult a business or contract attorney.

nodes.title: Employment or Housing Discrimination
nodes.escalation_message: Discrimination claims involve strict filing deadlines and complex legal requirements. You must typically file with an agency (EEOC or state equivalent) before you can sue. Missing these deadlines can permanently bar your claims. Consult an employment or civil rights attorney promptly.
resources: State DFEH or equivalent civil rights agency
Employment lawyers on contingency (American Association for Justice)

nodes.title: Medical Malpractice or Serious Personal Injury
nodes.escalation_message: Medical malpractice and serious personal injury cases are highly complex, require expert witnesses, and have strict statutes of limitations. These cases are typically taken on contingency by personal injury attorneys at no upfront cost to you.
resources: State bar personal injury lawyer referral
